title: On Thermodynamic Universalities and Optics of B-deformed Reissner--Nordström--AdS Black Holes
summary: Using machine learning techniques, we study the Reissner--Nordström--AdS black holes in the framework of extended space-time derivatives inspired by non-commutative geometry in string theory where the deformation parameters are related to the inverse of the NS-NS B-field. We refer to these solutions as B-deformed Reissner--Nordström--AdS black holes. Precisely, we examine the thermodynamic and the optical behaviors of such stringy deformed AdS black holes.
